pictures.name: QB1-Crowd
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. At the foot of a green mountain in Galilee, a crowd gathered on a dusty slope in afternoon light; a few disciples in simple robes argue with teachers of the law in fine robes. At the edge, a weathered Galilean farmer in his forties with a short greying beard, a brown wool tunic and a worn striped head cloth, stands holding his son, a thin boy of about twelve in a plain cream tunic close against his side, the boy resting his head on his father’s chest, eyes closed and peaceful. The father’s face tired from years of worry.
